haiku.description: Claude Haiku: the fastest and cheapest. Small, well-defined changes such as typos, renames, one-file edits and simple questions.

sonnet.description: Claude Sonnet: capable and mid-cost. Typical features and bug fixes across a few files, with tests.

opus.description: Claude Opus: the most capable and most expensive Claude model. Hard debugging, cross-cutting changes, architecture and ambiguous work.

codex.description: Codex: OpenAI's coding agent, a separate runtime. Well-specified implementation and test writing in a codebase.

efforts.high: Deep reasoning: unclear root cause, many interacting parts, or high risk.
